sentences.text: Elementary is an American procedural drama series that presents a contemporary update of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle 's character Sherlock Holmes .	drama	drama	Sir Arthur Conan Doyle	Sir Arthur Conan Doyle	procedural drama	procedural drama	Sherlock Holmes	Sherlock Holmes	Sherlock	Sherlock (TV series)

The series was created by Robert Doherty and stars Jonny Lee Miller as Sherlock Holmes and Lucy Liu as Dr. Joan Watson .	Robert Doherty	Robert Doherty (writer)	Jonny Lee Miller	Jonny Lee Miller	Lucy Liu	Lucy Liu	Sherlock Holmes	Sherlock Holmes	Dr. Joan Watson	Dr. Watson	Sherlock	Sherlock (TV series)
The series premiered on CBS on September 27 , 2012 .	CBS	CBS
The series is set and filmed primarily in New York City .	New York City	New York City

The show follows Holmes , a recovering drug addict and former consultant to Scotland Yard , as he assists the New York City Police Department in solving crimes .	New York City	New York City	consultant	consultant	Scotland Yard	Scotland Yard	New York City Police Department	New York City Police Department

He is accompanied by Dr. Joan Watson -LRB- Lucy Liu -RRB- , who initially acts as his sober companion .	Lucy Liu	Lucy Liu	Dr. Joan Watson	Dr. Watson	sober companion	sober companion
She is a former surgeon and was hired by Sherlock 's father to help him in his rehabilitation .	rehabilitation	Drug rehabilitation	Sherlock	Sherlock (TV series)

After the premiere , it was picked up for a full season and later an extra two episodes .

The series has since been well received by critics , who have praised the performances , writing , and novel approach to the source material .
On March 25 , 2016 , CBS renewed the series for a fifth season , which premiered on October 2 , 2016 .	CBS	CBS
